objective: Preserve the exact r3 RTL, SVA, TB, filelist, sealed V01-V20 campaign, frozen 17-cycle schedule, and public interface while repairing only the pre-compile VCS identity query from vcs -ID to vcs -full64 -ID. The r3 one-shot stopped before compile and is diagnostic only. This draft does not authorize execution or admit compilation, behavior, speedup, area, energy, PPA, or a paper claim.

sealed_v01_v20.V01: N=1 and N=4 gap-free ready-high contexts must retire in exactly 29 and 80 inclusive cycles.
sealed_v01_v20.V02: An independent full-precision integer oracle must produce zero tag, beat, mask, and event mismatch over zero, fixed-seed random, alternating-sign, and all-extreme signed-INT8 operands.
sealed_v01_v20.V03: The arithmetic campaign must hit just below, exactly at, and just above both signed-Q24 saturation rails and threshold equality, with saturate-then-compare semantics; the lower-rail context must use threshold -8388608 so unsaturated -8388609 cannot masquerade as the saturated equality event.
sealed_v01_v20.V04: Every issued multiplier slot must form a per-tile bijection of exactly 1600 unique row/lane/time tuples with masks 96 for cycles0-15 and 64 for cycle16.
sealed_v01_v20.V05: Back-to-back tiles filling both raw banks must have no issue bubble beyond 17-cycle service and must return oldest tags first.
sealed_v01_v20.V06: A deliberately older bank1 and newer bank0 dual-ready snapshot must cross a real sequential issue edge; bank1 ownership, tag, payload, and first result must win.
sealed_v01_v20.V07: Holding result_ready low through FIFO full and then pulsing credit must atomically stall close phases while prologue remains credit-independent, with no loss or duplication.
sealed_v01_v20.V08: A full FIFO simultaneous head pop and closing push must commit both pointer transitions and retain occupancy16; directed stalls must hit both phase12 and phase16.
sealed_v01_v20.V09: A stalled FIFO head must keep result tag, beat, valid mask, and data stable for multiple cycles.
sealed_v01_v20.V10: Configuration early-last on beats0-3 and missing beat4 last must create a registered sticky fault without committing the offending beat.
sealed_v01_v20.V11: Each of the 216 required-zero configuration padding bits 1064-1279 must be attacked individually and must fault.
sealed_v01_v20.V12: Raw early-last on beats0-3, missing beat4 last, and tag drift on beats1 and4 must create a registered sticky fault without committing the offending beat.
sealed_v01_v20.V13: Sustained valid traffic around every legal config/raw phase with two half-cycle probes must show zero protocol pulses, control retractions, or result changes.
sealed_v01_v20.V14: A malformed raw acceptance coincident with full FIFO pop and push must suppress the bad payload, commit the established pop/push, and quarantine on the next cycle.
sealed_v01_v20.V15: A legal configuration followed by a zero-tile release held for exactly eight consecutive sampled positive edges must never retire, must produce exactly one registered fault transition, and must remain in reset-only sticky quarantine thereafter.
sealed_v01_v20.V16: Held release must be tested during partial raw, dense cycles0/12/16, and FIFO-only drain; it must accept exactly once only after complete nonempty drain.
sealed_v01_v20.V17: Simultaneous raw_valid and release_valid at an empty configured context must give raw priority without a zero-tile fault on that edge.
sealed_v01_v20.V18: Reset must be attacked in exactly nine classes: partial config, partial raw, dense c0, dense c11, dense c12, dense c15, dense c16, FIFO-full close stall, and quarantine; every class must have an individual exact-one counter, deterministic empty reset state, and a clean exact N1=29 next context.
sealed_v01_v20.V19: Two or more legal contexts with opposite data and no payload clearing between releases must show no stale config, raw, accumulator, FIFO, or tag influence.
sealed_v01_v20.V20: The exact-SHA runner must self-check its externally frozen SHA, automatically execute a wrong-RTL-SHA negative control in a separate sealed directory, require exit10 before tool invocation, and cross-link that negative evidence into the positive receipt.
